##### Project general facts

The Autograph i Series Residence by Green Group is a 39-storey residential tower with a sleek contemporary design. The tower offers a variety of residential units, including studios, simplex and duplex apartments, as well as a limited collection of spacious sky villas. Selected units feature private pools, while the upper-floor residences offer panoramic views of the surrounding cityscape.

Residents have access to a range of amenities, including indoor and outdoor gyms, swimming pools and a coffee lounge. The building is surrounded by landscaped green areas and is pet-friendly, making it a comfortable home for residents with pets and those who value an active, balanced lifestyle.

The apartments are finished with modern, high-quality materials and functional layouts designed for comfortable living. Each unit comes with an equipped kitchen, and the residences are delivered unfurnished, allowing owners to personalise the interiors to their taste.

##### Location description and benefits

The project is located in Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC), a fast-growing residential community in Dubai. The neighbourhood is known for its distinctive circular layout, which brings together modern residential buildings and green open spaces.

JVC offers tree-lined streets, quiet parks and a mix of villas and apartments, creating a calm and welcoming atmosphere. The community provides a peaceful setting away from the busier parts of the city while remaining well connected to the rest of Dubai.

Residents of JVC have access to schools, shopping centres, parks and recreational facilities within the community. This makes the area a convenient choice for families, working professionals and investors.
